data.long_meaning: The meaning of Gerick is recorded in name-lists as “Powerful ruler”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gerick expresses “Powerful ruler”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gerick total 35, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
